invariants: category.id must be auto-incremented primary key
category.reorder_threshold must be an integer or null
product.id must be auto-incremented primary key
product.category_id must reference an existing category.id
product.price_cents must be a positive integer
product.stock_qty must be a non-negative integer
product.low_active is optional and defaults to False
category.reorder_threshold must be greater than or equal to 0 if provided
stock_qty must be updated to a non-negative integer when restocking
